entities.name: Dialectical Materialism
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: A philosophical framework synthesizing Hegel's dialectics with materialist ontology, arguing that material conditions and class struggle drive historical change. Developed by Marx and Engels, it became the theoretical foundation of communist movements worldwide, reshaping the geopolitics of the 20th century.
